sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, coalesce(o.strategy,'-') AS b, o.market_ticker AS c, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS d, o.limit_price::text AS e, o.quantity::text AS f, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS h FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 4) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.captured_at::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.avg_price::text,'-'), coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '12 minutes' AND (p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%') ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 6) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, o2.created_at::text, 'mmsell', coalesce(o2.strategy,'-'), coalesce(o2.side,'-'), o2.limit_price::text, o2.quantity::text, coalesce(o2.status,'-') FROM live_orders o2 WHERE o2.strategy LIKE 'Fmmsell%' ORDER BY o2.created_at DESC LIMIT 2)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
